files.initialValue:
version: 1
steps:
  - inspect: {}
  - preflight:
      checks:
        - "baseline"
  - execute:
      operation: "deploy"
      retry: "repeat"
  - execute:
      operation: "record"
      retry: "repeat"
  - postflight:
      onFailure: "ignore"
  - execute:
      operation: "contract"
      retry: "resume"
  - postflight:
      onFailure: "rollback"

cases.title: Contract completes
cases.description: Both health checks and irreversible authorization pass.

cases.title: Contract not authorized
cases.description: Production release is authorized; destructive contract is not.

cases.title: Failure past the rollback window
cases.description: Verification fails only after contract has committed.
